profile.headline: Senior Systems SWE at Nvidia | Unhinged Lunatic
profile.summary: Senior computer engineer with 6 years of experience in the semiconductor industry.  Self-starter with excellent software & hardware skills specializing in embedded AI and low-power microcontrollers.  Proven industry track record, including award-winning trade-show demos.  Passion for bridging the gap between the digital and physical world.

positions.title: Network Intern II
positions.description: Designed and prototyped IOT dust-storm detection network using embedded C, optical gates, and AWS cloud-based computing servers. Maintained IT infrastructure & support for two small offices in Golden, CO and Portland, OR. Designed, built, and maintained a network of servers and high-end computers for environmental modeling software that decreased computation time by 400%. Gained experience in deploying & maintaining AWS cloud-based computing clusters. Wrote software in Python for a wide range of applications in data science.
